title: STAR-XPC: Set Transformer for Estimating X-ray Transmission in Polymer Composites
abstract: arXiv:2610.28709v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating the energy transmission ratio of an X-ray beam through a polymer composite is a challenging task in radiation shielding studies. The reference solution with Monte Carlo transport simulation is highly accurate but computationally expensive: each of our reference simulations is capped at $4\times10^9$ photon histories and a 20,000 s (over 5 hours) time limit, while closed-form analytical methods fail to represent such complex scenarios. We present an artificial neural network model that maps the unordered multi-set of molecular constituents, their mass fractions, and four bulk physical descriptors directly to the transmission ratio $I(t)/I_0$ in 1-3 milliseconds. The model is a Set Transformer, which makes it permutation invariant by construction and accepts mixtures of different sizes up to 11 constituents within a fixed-size padded set. Each constituent is embedded with a chemistry-pretrained transformer language model, ChemBE

translated_title: STAR-XPC：用于估算聚合物复合材料X射线透射率的集合Transformer
translated_abstract: 在辐射屏蔽研究中，评估X射线束穿过聚合物复合材料的能量透射比是一项具有挑战性的任务。作为参考解的蒙特卡罗输运模拟方法精度很高，但计算成本极其昂贵：我们的每个参考模拟被限制在40亿（4×10⁹）光子历史数和20,000秒（超过5小时）的时间上限内，而闭式解析方法又无法表征如此复杂的场景。我们提出了一种人工神经网络模型，将分子组分的无序多重集、其质量分数以及四个整体物理描述符直接映射到透射比 I(t)/I₀，推理时间仅需1-3毫秒。该模型是一个集合Transformer（Set Transformer），在结构上具有置换不变性，并通过固定大小的填充集合接受最多含11种组分的不同规模混合物。每种组分均使用化学领域预训练的Transformer语言模型ChemBE进行嵌入……
tldr: 本文提出基于集合Transformer的STAR-XPC模型，可在1-3毫秒内快速准确估算聚合物复合材料的X射线透射比，替代耗时超过5小时的蒙特卡罗模拟。
en_tdlr: STAR-XPC, a Set Transformer-based neural network, estimates X-ray transmission ratios in polymer composites within 1-3 milliseconds, replacing computationally expensive Monte Carlo simulations that take over 5 hours.
